## Resumo A full command-palette landing page rendered in a calm graphite dark theme on a near-black canvas (#0e0e10) lit by two faint platinum radial washes: a sticky blurred nav, an editorial hero where a focused command palette (the '⌘K' overlay) sits as the centerpiece, then a 'Features' band of three glass cards over a hairline stat strip, a radial-lit 'Library' CTA card with a copyable npm install line, and a hairline footer. The palette itself is the product: a rounded-2xl graphite card with a deep multi-layer shadow, a live search input with a blinking caret, a scrollable grouped list (Pages / Actions / News) of icon rows with right-aligned keyboard shortcuts, a featured 'News' card, and a bottom hint bar (↑↓ navigate · ↵ select · powered by Modal). Built on a single platinum-on-graphite palette (#c7c7cc / #aeaeb2 / #8e8e93 over #161618-#363638 surfaces) with Inter for UI/body and JetBrains Mono for every keycap and numeral; depth comes from hairline white/8 borders, a faint SVG grain, inset top highlights, and one deep palette shadow rather than any color. ## Estilo Visual Use a calm graphite dark design system on a near-black canvas: body background #0e0e10 with two faint platinum radial washes (radial-gradient(1100px 620px at 78% -8%, rgba(199,199,204,0.10), transparent 62%) and radial-gradient(900px 540px at 6% 8%, rgba(199,199,204,0.05), transparent 60%)) plus a fixed fractal-noise SVG grain overlay at opacity ~0.4. There is NO accent hue: the entire palette is a graphite surface ramp (#161618 / #1c1c1e / #232325 / #2c2c2e / #363638, named graphite-900..700) plus a platinum text ramp (#c7c7cc default, #aeaeb2 soft, #8e8e93 dim) and pure white for active/primary text. Two Google Fonts: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700/800) for all UI and body, and JetBrains Mono (weights 400/500/600) for keycaps, version tags, stat numbers and the install line, set as font-sans and font-mono. Borders are always hairlines: 1px rgba(199,199,204,0.10) (a .hairline utility) — no heavy chrome. Primary buttons are a solid platinum fill (#c7c7cc) with graphite-900 text that brightens to white on hover; secondary buttons are a graphite-850/60 fill with a platinum/15 border. Headlines use a vertical text-gradient clip (linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #c7c7cc 100%), background-clip:text, transparent fill) with tight -0.03em tracking. Keycaps (.kbd) are JetBrains Mono on a rgba(199,199,204,0.10) fill with a rgba(199,199,204,0.16) border and a two-part shadow (0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4) drop + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05) highlight). The signature shadow is .palette-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(199,199,204,0.09) ring + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05) top highlight + 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.85) deep drop + 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.7) near drop, so the palette floats. The active list row (.row-active) is a 90deg linear-gradient(rgba(199,199,204,0.13), rgba(199,199,204,0.06)) with an inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(199,199,204,0.14) ring. Radii: cards/palette rounded-2xl, list rows/buttons rounded-lg/xl, keycaps and chips rounded/rounded-full. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify, all in platinum/platinum-soft, never colored. ## Layout e Estrutura ### Sticky blurred nav A `
` with a .nav-blur backdrop (backdrop-filter saturate(150%) blur(14px)), a `border-b` hairline and a bg-graphite-900/60 fill, wrapping a `max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 lg:px-8` row of `h-16 flex items-center justify-between`. Left: a brand lockup = a 32px rounded-lg bg-graphite-750 tile ringed platinum/15 holding a white Phosphor ph:command-bold icon, beside a 15px font-700 white 'Modal' wordmark and a small mono 'v2.4' version tag (rounded-md border-platinum/15 bg-graphite-800, hidden below sm). Center (hidden below md): four 13.5px platinum-soft links (Features, Live demo, Library, Docs) that hover to white. Right: a ghost 'Sign in' link (hidden below sm) and the primary CTA — a platinum-fill rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 'Open palette' button with graphite-900 text and an embedded dark '⌘K' keycap. ### Hero headline block A `relative overflow-hidden` section, inner `max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 pt-20 pb-10 lg:pt-28`. A centered `max-w-3xl` block: an eyebrow chip (rounded-full border-platinum/15 bg-graphite-850/70 px-3.5 py-1.5, a platinum ph:sparkle-fill icon + 'A prompt-driven command palette for any product'), a vertical-gradient H1 up to 68px ('The command palette / your users deserve.' with a `
`, text-gradient clip, -0.03em tracking, leading 1.04), a 17.5px platinum-soft lead, and two CTAs in a `flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3`: a platinum-fill 'Try the live demo' (ph:play-fill) and a graphite-850/60 + platinum/15-border 'Read the docs' with a trailing '⌘K' keycap. ### The command palette (the centerpiece) A `relative max-w-2xl mx-auto mt-16 scroll-mt-24` block (id=palette). Behind it a pointer-events-none `-inset-x-10 -inset-y-8 -z-10 rounded-[28px] bg-graphite-900/40 blur-2xl` framing glow. The palette itself: a `.palette-shadow overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-platinum/10 bg-graphite-850/95 backdrop-blur-xl` card with three stacked zones. (a) SEARCH INPUT row: `flex items-center gap-3 border-b hairline px-5 py-4` — a platinum-dim ph:magnifying-glass-bold, then a live 15.5px line showing a typed white 'Go to' + a 1.5px platinum blinking `.caret` + a platinum-dim placeholder 'Search pages, actions, anything…', and a right 'esc' keycap. (b) SCROLLABLE LIST: `.list-scroll max-h-[392px] overflow-y-auto px-2 py-2.5` with a custom thin platinum/16 scrollbar, holding three groups each led by an 11px uppercase tracking-0.12em platinum-dim label. (c) FOOTER HINT BAR (next part). ### Palette list groups + rows Inside the scrollable list, three groups. 'PAGES': four rows — the first row is `.row-active` (gradient highlight + inset ring) 'Home' with a white ph:house-bold tile + two 'G' 'H' keycaps; then 'Projects' (ph:briefcase-bold, right-aligned 'Action' label), 'Inbox' (ph:tray-bold, a rounded-full platinum/10 '3' badge), 'Settings' (ph:gear-six-bold, 'Link' label). Each row is a `flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5` button with a 28px rounded-md bg-graphite-750 ring-platinum/10 icon tile, a flex-1 14.5px label (white if active, else platinum), and a right meta (keycaps / count / type word); inactive rows hover to bg-platinum/[0.06]. 'ACTIONS': three rows — 'Create new project' (ph:plus-bold, ⌘ N), 'Invite teammate' (ph:user-circle-bold, ⌘ I), 'Toggle theme' (ph:moon-bold, 'Action'). 'NEWS': a single `.feat-card mx-1 mb-1 rounded-xl border-platinum/12 p-4` featured card — a 32px rounded-lg bg-platinum/12 tile (ph:cloud-bold), a white 'Introducing Edge functions' title, a platinum-soft body line, and a platinum 'Read the changelog' link with ph:arrow-right-bold. ### Palette footer hint bar + trust row Below the list, a `flex items-center justify-between border-t hairline px-4 py-2.5` hint bar: left, two 11.5px platinum-dim hints each pairing a keycap with a verb ('↑↓' keycap + 'navigate', '↵' keycap + 'select'); right, a platinum-dim ph:command-bold + 'powered by Modal'. Then, 40px below the palette, a `flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-8 gap-y-3 opacity-70` trust row: an 11.5px uppercase tracking-0.14em platinum-dim 'Trusted by teams at' label beside four 14px font-700 platinum-soft logo lockups, each a Phosphor glyph + name (ph:cube-bold Northwind, ph:hexagon-bold Polar, ph:circles-three-bold Lattice, ph:triangle-bold Vellum — Vellum hidden below sm). ### Features band + stat strip A `relative mt-20 border-y hairline bg-graphite-900/40` section (id=features), inner `max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 py-20 lg:px-8`. A left `max-w-2xl` intro: a 12.5px uppercase tracking-0.16em platinum-dim 'Why Modal' eyebrow, a 38px font-700 white H2 'See it in action.', and a platinum-soft lead. Then a `mt-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-px rounded-2xl border border-platinum/10 bg-platinum/10 overflow-hidden` — the bg-platinum/10 fill shows through the 1px gaps as hairline dividers between three bg-graphite-850 p-7 cards, each with a 40px rounded-xl bg-graphite-750 ring-platinum/10 icon tile (ph:moon-stars-bold / ph:sliders-horizontal-bold / ph:lightning-bold), a 17px font-600 white title (Built-in dark mode / Fully customizable / Instant search) and a platinum-soft body. Directly below, a `mt-px grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-px rounded-2xl border border-platinum/10 bg-platinum/10 overflow-hidden` stat strip of four bg-graphite-850 px-6 py-7 text-center cells, each a 30px JetBrains Mono white numeral over a 12.5px platinum-dim label (2.1kb gzipped / <30ms search latency / 19 edge regions / 0 config files). ### Library CTA card + footer A `relative` section (id=library), inner `max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 py-24 lg:px-8`, holding one `relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-platinum/12 bg-graphite-850 px-8 py-16 sm:px-16 text-center` card with a pointer-events-none radial top glow (radial-gradient(700px 360px at 50% -20%, rgba(199,199,204,0.12), transparent 60%)). Centered `max-w-xl` content: a 48px rounded-2xl bg-graphite-750 ring-platinum/15 icon tile (ph:command-bold), a 40px font-700 white H2 'Ship it before your coffee gets cold.', a platinum-soft lead, a copyable install pill (`inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border-platinum/12 bg-graphite-900/70 px-4 py-3 font-mono text-13.5px` showing '$ npm i @modal/cmdk' with a platinum-dim ph:copy-bold), and two CTAs (a platinum-fill 'Get started free' + a platinum/15-border 'Browse the prompt library'). Then the footer (id=docs): a `border-t hairline bg-graphite-900/50` band, inner `max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 py-12 lg:px-8`, with a `flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-8` top row (brand lockup + 5 platinum-soft nav links: Features, Demo, Library, GitHub, Changelog) over a `mt-10 border-t hairline pt-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between gap-3` bottom row (a platinum-dim '© 2026 Modal Design' line + a 'Press ⌘K anywhere to begin.' line with an embedded keycap). ## Componentes Especiais de UI ### Componente The signature centerpiece component: a `rounded-2xl border border-platinum/10 bg-graphite-850/95 backdrop-blur-xl overflow-hidden` card carried by a `.palette-shadow` (a platinum/9 ring + inset top highlight + a 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.85) deep drop + a 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.7) near drop) with a soft `bg-graphite-900/40 blur-2xl` framing glow behind it, so it reads as floating over the page. Three stacked zones: a search-input row (magnifier + a live typed query 'Go to' with a 1.5px platinum blinking caret + a dim placeholder + an 'esc' keycap, separated by a hairline border-b), a scrollable max-h-[392px] grouped list with a custom thin platinum scrollbar, and a hairline-topped footer hint bar. Use it as the live demo embedded in the hero rather than a static screenshot. ### Componente A keyboard-navigable list inside the palette: 11px uppercase tracking-0.12em platinum-dim group labels (Pages / Actions / News) over `flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5` rows. Each row = a 28px rounded-md bg-graphite-750 ring-platinum/10 icon tile (Phosphor) + a flex-1 14.5px label + a right-aligned meta slot that can hold mono keycaps (G H, ⌘ N), a small type word ('Action' / 'Link' in platinum-dim), or a rounded-full platinum/10 count badge. Exactly one row is `.row-active` = a 90deg linear-gradient(rgba(199,199,204,0.13), rgba(199,199,204,0.06)) + an inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(199,199,204,0.14) ring with a white label and white icon; all other rows hover to bg-platinum/[0.06]. The last group ('News') swaps rows for a single `.feat-card` featured card (linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(199,199,204,0.05), rgba(199,199,204,0.015)) fill) with an icon tile, title, body and a 'Read the changelog' arrow link. ### Componente A reusable keyboard-cap chip used everywhere keys appear (nav ⌘K, search 'esc', row shortcuts G/H/⌘N/⌘I, footer hints ↑↓/↵, footer ⌘K): JetBrains Mono on a rgba(199,199,204,0.10) fill with a 1px rgba(199,199,204,0.16) border, rounded, px-1.5 py-0.5, ~10-11px, platinum-soft text, and a two-part shadow (0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4) drop + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05) highlight) so it reads as a physical key. The on-platinum-button variant inverts (dark fill rgba(22,22,24,0.12) / dark border / no shadow / graphite-900 text). ### Componente A grid pattern that fakes 1px dividers without per-cell borders: a `grid gap-px rounded-2xl border border-platinum/10 bg-platinum/10 overflow-hidden` wrapper whose bg-platinum/10 fill shows through the `gap-px` seams, with each cell a solid bg-graphite-850 panel. Used for both the 3-up feature cards and the 4-up mono stat strip (which are stacked with only a `mt-px` between them so they read as one continuous bordered block). ### Componente An `inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-platinum/12 bg-graphite-900/70 px-4 py-3 font-mono text-13.5px` pill in the CTA card: a platinum-dim '$' prompt, a white 'npm i' with a platinum-tinted '@modal/cmdk' package name, and a trailing platinum-dim ph:copy-bold that brightens to white on hover, signalling click-to-copy. ## Notas Especiais Two Google Fonts: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700/800) as font-sans for all UI and body; JetBrains Mono (weights 400/500/600) as font-mono for every keycap, the 'v2.4' version tag, the four stat numerals and the npm install line — mono is a deliberate texture that signals 'keyboard-first', not just code. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify, always platinum/platinum-soft/platinum-dim, never colored (ph:command-bold, ph:sparkle-fill, ph:play-fill, ph:magnifying-glass-bold, ph:house-bold, ph:briefcase-bold, ph:tray-bold, ph:gear-six-bold, ph:plus-bold, ph:user-circle-bold, ph:moon-bold, ph:cloud-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:cube-bold, ph:hexagon-bold, ph:circles-three-bold, ph:triangle-bold, ph:moon-stars-bold, ph:sliders-horizontal-bold, ph:lightning-bold, ph:copy-bold). Exact tokens — page background #0e0e10; graphite surface ramp graphite-900 #161618 / 850 #1c1c1e / 800 #232325 / 750 #2c2c2e / 700 #363638; platinum text ramp #c7c7cc (default) / #aeaeb2 (soft) / #8e8e93 (dim) plus pure white for active/primary; there is NO accent hue. Hairline border = rgba(199,199,204,0.10). Effects: two faint platinum radial body washes (rgba(199,199,204,0.10) at 78% -8% and rgba(199,199,204,0.05) at 6% 8%), a fixed fractal-noise SVG `.grain` overlay at opacity 0.4, the `.palette-shadow` multi-layer float (platinum/9 ring + inset top highlight + 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.85) + 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)), the `.row-active` gradient + inset ring, the `.kbd` two-part keycap shadow, a vertical-gradient `.text-gradient` headline clip (#ffffff -> #c7c7cc), and a radial CTA-card glow. The whole page is a `sticky top-0 z-50` blurred nav over four max-w-6xl regions (hero, features band, library CTA, footer) and reflows cleanly to a single column at smaller widths: the hero headline drops its `
`, all CTA pairs and card grids collapse to one column, the stat strip goes 4-col -> 2-col, and the nav links + 'Sign in' hide while the 'Open palette' button and primary CTAs persist. Accessibility/clarity intent: hierarchy is carried entirely by the platinum grey ramp + weight + the active-row highlight (no color needed), keycaps spell out the shortcut for every action, and the search input shows a real focused/typing state with a blinking caret.

prompts.partPt: Recursos e Diferenciais band + stat strip
prompts.prompt: A `relative mt-20 border-y hairline bg-graphite-900/40` section (id=features), inner `max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 py-20 lg:px-8`. A left `max-w-2xl` intro: a 12.5px uppercase tracking-0.16em platinum-dim 'Why Modal' eyebrow, a 38px font-700 white H2 'See it in action.', and a platinum-soft lead. Then a `mt-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-px rounded-2xl border border-platinum/10 bg-platinum/10 overflow-hidden` — the bg-platinum/10 fill shows through the 1px gaps as hairline dividers between three bg-graphite-850 p-7 cards, each with a 40px rounded-xl bg-graphite-750 ring-platinum/10 icon tile (ph:moon-stars-bold / ph:sliders-horizontal-bold / ph:lightning-bold), a 17px font-600 white title (Built-in dark mode / Fully customizable / Instant search) and a platinum-soft body. Directly below, a `mt-px grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-px rounded-2xl border border-platinum/10 bg-platinum/10 overflow-hidden` stat strip of four bg-graphite-850 px-6 py-7 text-center cells, each a 30px JetBrains Mono white numeral over a 12.5px platinum-dim label (2.1kb gzipped / <30ms search latency / 19 edge regions / 0 config files).

prompts.partPt: Library Chamada Final para Ação card + Rodapé
prompts.prompt: A `relative` section (id=library), inner `max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 py-24 lg:px-8`, holding one `relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-platinum/12 bg-graphite-850 px-8 py-16 sm:px-16 text-center` card with a pointer-events-none radial top glow (radial-gradient(700px 360px at 50% -20%, rgba(199,199,204,0.12), transparent 60%)). Centered `max-w-xl` content: a 48px rounded-2xl bg-graphite-750 ring-platinum/15 icon tile (ph:command-bold), a 40px font-700 white H2 'Ship it before your coffee gets cold.', a platinum-soft lead, a copyable install pill (`inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border-platinum/12 bg-graphite-900/70 px-4 py-3 font-mono text-13.5px` showing '$ npm i @modal/cmdk' with a platinum-dim ph:copy-bold), and two CTAs (a platinum-fill 'Get started free' + a platinum/15-border 'Browse the prompt library'). Then the footer (id=docs): a `border-t hairline bg-graphite-900/50` band, inner `max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 py-12 lg:px-8`, with a `flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-8` top row (brand lockup + 5 platinum-soft nav links: Features, Demo, Library, GitHub, Changelog) over a `mt-10 border-t hairline pt-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between gap-3` bottom row (a platinum-dim '© 2026 Modal Design' line + a 'Press ⌘K anywhere to begin.' line with an embedded keycap).

special_ui_components.prompt: The signature centerpiece component: a `rounded-2xl border border-platinum/10 bg-graphite-850/95 backdrop-blur-xl overflow-hidden` card carried by a `.palette-shadow` (a platinum/9 ring + inset top highlight + a 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.85) deep drop + a 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.7) near drop) with a soft `bg-graphite-900/40 blur-2xl` framing glow behind it, so it reads as floating over the page. Three stacked zones: a search-input row (magnifier + a live typed query 'Go to' with a 1.5px platinum blinking caret + a dim placeholder + an 'esc' keycap, separated by a hairline border-b), a scrollable max-h-[392px] grouped list with a custom thin platinum scrollbar, and a hairline-topped footer hint bar. Use it as the live demo embedded in the hero rather than a static screenshot.

A keyboard-navigable list inside the palette: 11px uppercase tracking-0.12em platinum-dim group labels (Pages / Actions / News) over `flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5` rows. Each row = a 28px rounded-md bg-graphite-750 ring-platinum/10 icon tile (Phosphor) + a flex-1 14.5px label + a right-aligned meta slot that can hold mono keycaps (G H, ⌘ N), a small type word ('Action' / 'Link' in platinum-dim), or a rounded-full platinum/10 count badge. Exactly one row is `.row-active` = a 90deg linear-gradient(rgba(199,199,204,0.13), rgba(199,199,204,0.06)) + an inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(199,199,204,0.14) ring with a white label and white icon; all other rows hover to bg-platinum/[0.06]. The last group ('News') swaps rows for a single `.feat-card` featured card (linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(199,199,204,0.05), rgba(199,199,204,0.015)) fill) with an icon tile, title, body and a 'Read the changelog' arrow link.

A reusable keyboard-cap chip used everywhere keys appear (nav ⌘K, search 'esc', row shortcuts G/H/⌘N/⌘I, footer hints ↑↓/↵, footer ⌘K): JetBrains Mono on a rgba(199,199,204,0.10) fill with a 1px rgba(199,199,204,0.16) border, rounded, px-1.5 py-0.5, ~10-11px, platinum-soft text, and a two-part shadow (0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4) drop + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05) highlight) so it reads as a physical key. The on-platinum-button variant inverts (dark fill rgba(22,22,24,0.12) / dark border / no shadow / graphite-900 text).

A grid pattern that fakes 1px dividers without per-cell borders: a `grid gap-px rounded-2xl border border-platinum/10 bg-platinum/10 overflow-hidden` wrapper whose bg-platinum/10 fill shows through the `gap-px` seams, with each cell a solid bg-graphite-850 panel. Used for both the 3-up feature cards and the 4-up mono stat strip (which are stacked with only a `mt-px` between them so they read as one continuous bordered block).

An `inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-platinum/12 bg-graphite-900/70 px-4 py-3 font-mono text-13.5px` pill in the CTA card: a platinum-dim '$' prompt, a white 'npm i' with a platinum-tinted '@modal/cmdk' package name, and a trailing platinum-dim ph:copy-bold that brightens to white on hover, signalling click-to-copy.

structured.special_notes:
Two Google Fonts: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700/800) as font-sans for all UI and body; JetBrains Mono (weights 400/500/600) as font-mono for every keycap, the 'v2.4' version tag, the four stat numerals and the npm install line — mono is a deliberate texture that signals 'keyboard-first', not just code. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify, always platinum/platinum-soft/platinum-dim, never colored (ph:command-bold, ph:sparkle-fill, ph:play-fill, ph:magnifying-glass-bold, ph:house-bold, ph:briefcase-bold, ph:tray-bold, ph:gear-six-bold, ph:plus-bold, ph:user-circle-bold, ph:moon-bold, ph:cloud-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:cube-bold, ph:hexagon-bold, ph:circles-three-bold, ph:triangle-bold, ph:moon-stars-bold, ph:sliders-horizontal-bold, ph:lightning-bold, ph:copy-bold). Exact tokens — page background #0e0e10; graphite surface ramp graphite-900 #161618 / 850 #1c1c1e / 800 #232325 / 750 #2c2c2e / 700 #363638; platinum text ramp #c7c7cc (default) / #aeaeb2 (soft) / #8e8e93 (dim) plus pure white for active/primary; there is NO accent hue. Hairline border = rgba(199,199,204,0.10). Effects: two faint platinum radial body washes (rgba(199,199,204,0.10) at 78% -8% and rgba(199,199,204,0.05) at 6% 8%), a fixed fractal-noise SVG `.grain` overlay at opacity 0.4, the `.palette-shadow` multi-layer float (platinum/9 ring + inset top highlight + 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.85) + 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)), the `.row-active` gradient + inset ring, the `.kbd` two-part keycap shadow, a vertical-gradient `.text-gradient` headline clip (#ffffff -> #c7c7cc), and a radial CTA-card glow. The whole page is a `sticky top-0 z-50` blurred nav over four max-w-6xl regions (hero, features band, library CTA, footer) and reflows cleanly to a single column at smaller widths: the hero headline drops its `
`, all CTA pairs and card grids collapse to one column, the stat strip goes 4-col -> 2-col, and the nav links + 'Sign in' hide while the 'Open palette' button and primary CTAs persist. Accessibility/clarity intent: hierarchy is carried entirely by the platinum grey ramp + weight + the active-row highlight (no color needed), keycaps spell out the shortcut for every action, and the search input shows a real focused/typing state with a blinking caret.
